newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Atok shares rise stopped for second day.
newsitem.headline: Atok shares rise stopped for second day.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange stopped further price appreciation of Atok-Big Wedge Co Inc for the second day, after gaining another 48 percent in early Thursday trade, a bourse official said.

The bourse limited the rise of the recently-converted holding company after it reached 34 centavos, up 12 centavos from the previous day's close. The company rose by about 48 percent to 23 centavos on Wednesday.
The company said it did not know of any material information which could propel the steady rise of its stock.
The share price had settled back to 24 centavos by midsession.
The bourse automatically freezes further fluctuation of a share price after it rises by about 50 percent, or falls by 45 percent within a single day.
